rows.en: <operator(12051,1)><speed(2)>...Sure are a lot of unfamiliar faces around here! I'm <color(4)>Ryoko Subaru<ce()>! Nice to meet you!
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>It's been a while, <color(4)>Ryoko<ce()>.
rows.notes: Polite '-san' on Ryoko dropped, per project convention.

rows.en: <operator(12051,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... two years, huh. You look well.
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>Aaargh, no good!!
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>The <color(4)>Amaterasu<ce()>'s computers are fighting each other!
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>I can't make heads or tails of it!!
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>But you managed to peek at some of the data, right?
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... something's off! There's a block that's not in the official blueprints, and this data too...!
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Boson Jump experiment, specimen list... Just as I thought. So there's a reason we were attacked, after all.
rows.notes: 'higensha' (test subject) rendered 'specimen' to avoid the lowercase j in 'subject'.

rows.en: <operator(12051,2)><speed(2)>Hey! You're hacking someone else's system, aren't you?!
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>It's an emergency. Oh, and by the way, the one actually responsible is this <color(4)>Harry<ce()> here...
rows.notes: '-kun' on Harry dropped, per project convention.

rows.en: <operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>C-Captain, that's harsh!
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>...? <color(4)>Harry<ce()>, what's that on the screen?
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>Huh...? Is this... a warning message...?
<operator(12012,1)><speed(2)>OTIKA OTIKA OTIKA OTIKA OTIKA OTIKA OTIKA OTIKA OTIKA
rows.notes: Source is full-width Latin 'OTIKA' repeated 9x, no real Japanese; kept verbatim since it reads as AKITO reversed (speaker id 12012 resolves to the short label 'Akito' with no full name), a foreshadowing device, not translatable text.

rows.en: <operator(12051,2)><speed(2)>Whoa?! What is this... gibberish text everywhere?!
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>This is...
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>What is this?! It's flooding us with access attempts!
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>...Anyway, let's launch, for now.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>The Hisago Plan is that thing that's always on the news, isn't it?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Sorry, I don't really know it. I don't watch much TV.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Really? I thought it was famous.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>But to think a fight could break out even in a place like that... War really has begun, hasn't it...
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>What in the world is going on...?
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>It seems the <color(4)>Amaterasu<ce()> has an unofficial block that isn't disclosed even to the military.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Over these two years, A-class Jumpers keep vanishing or meeting accidents, one after another.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>So something suspicious is being hidden, is that it...
<operator(10010,2)><speed(2)>Heheh, what a big operation's come our way!
<operator(10020,2)><speed(2)>Let's show 'em what we've got - time for the <color(4)>Dragonar Team<ce()> to shine!
<operator(10030,2)><speed(2)>In that case, leave it to me. I'll back you both up properly.
<operator(25010,2)><speed(2)>Hey kid, are you used to it yet?
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>...Huh?! Uh, well, not really, still...
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)>It's okay, <color(4)>Renton<ce()>. <color(4)>Nirvash<ce()> says it's fine too.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Just don't drag <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> down.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>I-I know! I'll show you I can fly it right!
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Ugh, why do I have to do this...!
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Is this really the time to be whining?!
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>'s right. A man's got times he simply has to do it... or something like that.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>That makes it sound like I'm some kind of coward!
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I'm a man! I'll get it done!
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>Ever since we got here, it's nothing but people we don't know a thing about. Doesn't sit right with me.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>We're not that different ourselves. We're a ragtag bunch too.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>The people over here are something else, building a thing like this.
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>Now I get why the <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()> is that strong...
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>This isn't the time to be impressed... The enemy is one even the <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()> senses as a threat.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>I know. Let's go!
<operator(12051,1)><speed(2)>Still, there sure are a lot of new faces. Even Gundams I've never seen before...
<operator(17030,2)><speed(2)>Heh, she's pretty cute. Maybe we can have a nice long talk later...
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>What are the other two up to?
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Hikaru<ce()> is a manga artist, and <color(4)>Izumi<ce()> runs a bar, from what I hear.
rows.notes: '-san' on both names dropped, per project convention.

rows.en: <operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>What are you all talking about?
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>We're talking about the pilots who used to ride the old <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()>.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I wonder what kind of people they really were...

uncertainties.issue: Garbled 'OTIKA' warning text kept verbatim (not translated) - it is Latin script already and its point is spelling AKITO backward; speaker id 12012 has only a short label 'Akito' in the game's own speaker table, confirming the reading.
'garoodo no iu toori da na. otoko nya yaraneba naran toki ga aru...tte na' - Gain paraphrasing/quoting a saying; rendered as his own remark referencing Garrod's line.
